summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Anti-Bribery and Anti-Fraud Programs in the public sector. Equip yourself to combat corruption effectively.
lede: Anti-bribery and anti-fraud training for public-sector professionals covers how to assess integrity risks and build practical controls. It is designed for managers, compliance and ethics officers, auditors, risk managers, procurement professionals and finance staff who need to map risks, design preventive measures, use red flags and data to spot concerns, and triage allegations. Participants also learn to review program effectiveness and plan improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public sector professionals who play a pivotal role in preventing, detecting, or responding to bribery and fraud.
audience: Senior and mid-level public sector managers
Compliance and ethics officers in ministries, regulators
Internal auditors and risk managers in government
Investigation and inspection teams within anti-corruption, ombudsman
modules: Foundations of Bribery and Fraud in the Public Sector
Fraud and Bribery Risk Assessment in Public Institutions
Red Flags, Detection Techniques, and Data Use
Procurement Integrity and Third-Party Risk Management
Ethics, Culture, and Leadership for Integrity
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Continuous Improvement of Programs
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of public sector operations and a commitment to enhancing integrity and accountability within their organizations.
